onChange.template:
[Gameplan: update .gameplan/locomotion/properties/ground_movement.schema.json, set gm_c_style to {{gm_c_style}}]
Set ground movement style to {{gm_c_style}}: snappy=fast accel and decel, balanced=defaults, floaty=slow accel high airtime.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/locomotion/properties/ground_movement.schema.json, set gm_c_rotation to {{gm_c_rotation}}]
Set MovementAbility.strafeMode: face_movement=character faces movement direction, strafe=character faces camera forward.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/locomotion/properties/ground_movement.schema.json, set gm_c_force_mode to {{gm_c_force_mode}}]
Set MovementAbility.useForceAsInputs: kinematic=false (direct delta), force_based=true (addForce physics-driven).

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/locomotion/properties/ground_movement.schema.json, set gm_t_move_speed to {{gm_t_move_speed}}]
Set MovementAbility.moveSpeed to {{gm_t_move_speed}} for the player character.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/locomotion/properties/ground_movement.schema.json, set gm_t_rotation_speed to {{gm_t_rotation_speed}}]
Set MovementAbility.rotationSpeed to {{gm_t_rotation_speed}}. Higher=snappier facing direction changes.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/locomotion/properties/ground_movement.schema.json, set gm_t_accel_time to {{gm_t_accel_time}}]
Set MovementAbility.accelerationTime to {{gm_t_accel_time}} seconds.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/locomotion/properties/ground_movement.schema.json, set gm_t_decel_factor to {{gm_t_decel_factor}}]
Set MovementAbility.decelerationFactor to {{gm_t_decel_factor}}. Higher=faster braking on direction change.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/locomotion/properties/ground_movement.schema.json, set gm_t_air_control to {{gm_t_air_control}}]
Set MovementAbility.airControlFactor to {{gm_t_air_control}}. Multiplier on acceleration time while airborne.
